children: PesoRama reported Q2 FY2027 results: revenue rose 59% YoY on 50% more stores and 4% comparable store sales growth, and the company repaid its senior secured facility in full. Figures are in Canadian dollars.

Detail
AI Analyst View
Q2 revenue up 59% YoY
Signals strong top-line acceleration, a key driver for valuation and liquidity in a small-cap retailer.
Store count up 50% YoY
Expansion is fueling growth; sustainability of new-store productivity is pivotal.
Same store sales up 4%
Positive comp shows underlying demand beyond footprint growth; pricing/traffic holding.
Senior secured facility repaid
Deleveraging improves balance sheet flexibility and reduces interest burden.
Context by AI Analyst

The update extends a growth-through-expansion story with improving comps and balance sheet cleanup. A fuller catalyst needs hard IFRS metrics (profitability, margins, cash flow) and guidance clarity to confirm operating leverage.
